name: Ai Suru Tsuma, Reina no Uwaki Kokuhaku "O, Ore yori Kimochi Yokatta no ka...?" → "...Un. Sugokatta"
original_name: 愛する妻、玲奈の浮気告白『お、俺より気持ち良かったのか…？』→『…うん。凄かった』
source:
Kazuma and Reina were newlyweds.
After making love, they lay together in a lazy, intimate haze, still naked, enjoying sweet, idle conversation.
In the middle of it, Reina suddenly asked:

"Have you ever… been with someone else?"

Kazuma sighed inwardly but answered honestly.
"Yeah. Just with… you know, escorts. Sorry."
Then, he turned the question back to her.
"What about you? Have you ever… been with someone else?"

Reina paused, thinking.
Her hesitation sent a faint shock through Kazuma, but he kept his calm.

Reina answered in a small voice.
"Well… actually… just a little."

"…Huh?"
What followed was a confession Kazuma never expected.
In vivid detail, Reina began to describe the intense affair she’d had with another man—something that had happened without Kazuma’s knowledge.
The words spilled from the lips of the woman he loved, each one deepening his despair.


[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ005930.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
和真与玲奈新婚不久。
云雨过后，两人赤裸相拥，慵懒而亲昵地闲聊着。
聊到一半，玲奈忽然问道：

“你……有没有和别人上过床？”

和真在心里叹了口气，还是如实回答。
“有。就……你知道的，找过性服务。对不起。”
说完，他又把问题抛回给她。
“那你呢？你……有没有和别人上过床？”

玲奈停下来想了想。
她的迟疑让和真心头微震，但他仍强作镇定。

玲奈低声回答：
“那个……其实……有一点。”

“……什么？”
接下来，是和真从未料想过的坦白。
玲奈开始生动地讲述自己瞒着和真、与另一名男子炽烈偷情的经历。
那些话从他深爱的女人唇间不断流出，每一个字都令他的绝望更深一分。
